summary: The exports bucket was pinned at 50 MiB, but the book's zip (about 150-250 photos at 3000 px) is expected around 300-400 MiB, so the real export would have been refused at upload.
fix: The exports bucket is 450 MiB (under the 512 MB /tmp the zip is built in, and under a 500 MB project-wide limit); free-plan projects use --free-plan (50 MB). The runbook has the dashboard step for the project-wide limit.
